# Xtreme Machines

> Xtreme Machines is an ISO 9001:2000 certified manufacturer and exporter of Rubber and Plastic Processing Machinery, based in New Delhi, India. The company (originally established as Kneader House in 1982) specializes in Filler & Masterbatch Compounding/Pelletizing Lines, Dispersion Kneaders, and Single Shaft Shredders, serving industries such as PVC cable, footwear, packaging, bio-polymers, and recycling. Xtreme Machines exports to markets including Spain, Dubai, Saudi Arabia, Venezuela, Iraq, Jordan, South Africa, Kenya, Nigeria, Nepal, and Bangladesh.

Key facts:
- Proprietor: Kulwant Singh (Monty Singh)
- Registered office: Plot No. 72/6, Khasra No. 72/9/2/1, Metro Pillar #485, Swarn Park, Mundka, Rohtak Road, New Delhi 110041, India
- Contact: +91 9810322070 / +91 9873300087, info@xtrememachines.in
- Infrastructure: ~2000 sq. yard in-house manufacturing unit with R&D team
- Compounding line capacities: 25, 50, 100, 150, 200, 350, 700, 1200 KG/HR
- Shredder capacities: 100 kg/hr to 2000 kg/hr
- Materials handled: PVC, PE, LLDPE, HDPE, EVA, TPR, PP, PBAT, PLA, PBS, corn starch/bio-polymers, ZHFR (zero halogen flame retardant) compounds, reclaim rubber

## Products

- [Compounding Line (Home)](https://www.xtrememachines.in/): Masterbatch & filler compounding/pelletizing lines (kneader-based) for Calcium, Talc, and Sodium-based fillers in polymers like PP, PE, LLDPE, PVC, TPR, EVA, and bio-polymers (PBAT, PLA, PBS). Includes PVC Compounding Line, Corn Starch/Bio Polymer Filler Compounding Machine, EVA Filler Compounding Line, TPR Filler Compounding Line, PE Filler Compounding Line, and ZHFR Cable Filler Machine. Applications: bio polymer, non-woven/woven sack/carry/garbage bags, tarpaulins, engineering plastics, PVC cable compounding, PVC footwear & soles, pipe & tank industries, injection moulding.
- [Dispersion Kneader Machine](https://www.xtrememachines.in/dispersion-kneader-machine/): Pneumatic/Hydraulic dispersion kneader (rubber kneader) for mixing, blending and dispersing Reclaim Rubber, Natural & Synthetic Rubber, EVA, and engineering plastics. Used across plastic industries (PVC artificial leather, PVC floor tile/sheet, PE for cables, HIPS/ABS, PVC/EVA toys, LDPE/LLDPE/HDPE) and rubber industries (shoe soles, rubber sponge/sandal, tyres & tubes, rain boots, marine fenders, conveyor belts, sports balls, O-rings, rubber toys).
- [Single Shaft Shredder](https://www.xtrememachines.in/single-shaft-shredder/): Lumps shredder (100 kg/hr–2000 kg/hr) for shredding PP, PC, HDPE, Nylon, LLDPE, PET lumps and other hard/rigid plastic waste. Blades made of high-grade Alloy Steel D2 (600-800 tons per blade set capacity). Used in recycling, waste management, and wood/paper processing. Die Face Cutters (Air & Water) also available on demand.
